Canonical research core · lean

Canonical rank-three prefix and peeled tail

For q >= 10, the canonical live columns start [0,2,5], with queues [0], [0,1], [0,1,2,3]; scanning them emits [1,2,4] before the remaining tail.

Lean verified (stated scope)

Scientific review

Review verdict: passed. Evidence and exact scope are linked above.

Hypotheses and scope

  • The canonical-game prefix requires q >= 10. The separate scan identity holds for any supplied queue tail T, with empty initial forcing and history.

Formalization correspondence

The actual-game source-queue theorems discharge each of the three fixed queues. liveCols_rank3_prefix and canonicalQState_rank3_prefix preserve the filtered live tail from columns 6 through q-1. scanQueues_rank3_peel is an exact equality retaining both output and survivor tails; canonical_rank3_peeled_tail bundles these identities.

Verification evidence

This corrected source snapshot passed a new clean strict build, exhaustive serialized and elaborated declaration/axiom census, and five fresh Lean kernel replays. Exact source/type correspondence and unchanged logical declarations after the documented comment corrections were checked separately. Only the standard propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound axioms were observed. Module and compiler-declaration counts are not counts of independent mathematical theorems.
